claims.claim: It is an Xbox One S
claims.evidence: Witness report lists model as null; photos show Xbox branding but not the One S model.
Storage capacity is listed as not shown in the witness report.
Photos show a black controller, but wireless type and inclusion are not confirmed.
No photo shows the console screen or system interface.
Exterior photos cannot reveal opening or repair history.
Still photos cannot test ports or thermals.
Photo shows one controller, but originality and quantity are unverified.
No receipt appears in any photo.

risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the Xbox dashboard
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working console / for parts

risks.risk: Disc drive does not read or eject discs
risks.proof: Video of a disc being inserted, read, and ejected
risks.if_unproven: Priced as disc drive not working

risks.risk: Controller buttons or analog sticks are faulty
risks.proof: Close-up video of the controller being tested or an input-test screenshot
risks.if_unproven: Priced as controller faulty or excluded

risks.if_unproven: Priced as console only, no cables

risks.proof: Screenshot of system storage settings showing 1TB
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest capacity variant

risks.proof: Photo of the original Xbox box

risks.risk: UK receipt is missing or invalid

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen
Video of the disc drive accepting, reading, and ejecting a disc
Close-up video of the controller buttons and analog sticks
Photo of the power cord and HDMI cable
Screenshot of the storage settings screen

response.reason: The witness identifies a white Xbox console with a disc slot and a controller, so it can be priced at its worst case; untested functions and unverified accessories are treated as absent until proof is provided.
